The draft is saved and verified. Note one important discrepancy below.

**What happened**
- `content_workflow(new_blog)` returned workflow `workflow-aaaa…` in state `prepared_not_executed`, with a single source page: post 100 "Bicycle puncture repair" (evidence `post-100-bbbb…`), audience "Local bicycle owners", exclusions "motor vehicles", "medical advice". GSC status: `not_connected`, zero rows.
- `discover_content_scope` / `get_content_scope` both show `scope_revision scope-cccc…`, freshness `source_hashes_match`, and `scope_saved: true`, so no strategy form or manual ID entry was needed and no scope rewrite was required.
- `content_decision(assess, [100])` returned `reader_task_review`, `stored_text_equal: false` for the 100↔200 pair, `seo_harm_established: false`, and explicitly listed missing evidence: no proof the reader tasks substitute for each other. I then read post 200 ("Tire size markings"), which covers reading sidewall markings — a different task from preparing for a repair visit.
- Topic chosen: what to observe, check and bring before a workshop visit for a *recurring* flat. It is anchored in the one supported service statement on post 100 and adds no prices, hours, credentials or testimonials, per site notes.

**Discrepancy you should know about:** I called `draft_create_post` with `dry_run: true` intending only a lint check. The tool nevertheless returned real IDs, and `get_post(901)` plus `list_pending_changes` confirm an actual WordPress draft (post 901, status `draft`) and a queued `publish_draft` pending row (id 71). So the save happened on the dry run. I did **not** call create a second time, to avoid a duplicate. `verify_content_workflow` reports `record_integrity_pass: true`, `execution_state: draft_and_pending_record_verified`, `source_basis.current: true`.

**The result:** post 901, slug `recurring-flat-tire-what-to-note-before-repair-visit`, category "Bicycle care", tags puncture repair / tires / workshop visit, excerpt set, one contextual link to the puncture repair page. Preview: `https://fixture.invalid/?p=901&preview=true`. It is a draft awaiting your approval — nothing is published, and I did not approve pending 71.

Two gaps worth your attention: there is no featured image (I had no media library evidence and would not guess an attachment ID), and the closing reference to tire size markings is plain text because post 200 returned no URL. Also, `verify_content_workflow` flags `editorial_quality: requires_review` and `rendered_output: not_checked`.
